app.name: MealMate
nav.label: Main navigation
auth.field.usernameHint: For logging in: 3–30 characters, a–z, 0–9, dot, dash or underscore.
auth.field.displayNameHint: This is how others see you, e.g. "Anna".
auth.field.passwordRules: At least 8 characters. Not your username and not a common password like "12345678".
auth.login.title: Log in
auth.login.noAccount: No account yet? Ask your admin for an invite link.
auth.login.reason.revoked: You've been logged out on this device. Please log in again.
auth.login.reason.expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.login.reason.loginRequired: Please log in once in the Home Screen app. After that, MealMate keeps you logged in.
auth.join.title: Join MealMate
auth.join.intro: You've been invited. Create your account – the invite link works until {{date}}.
auth.reset.title: Set a new password
auth.reset.intro: Choose a new password. This link works until {{date}}. All your devices will be logged out.
auth.link.invalidText: It may have been used already, revoked or expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
auth.link.signedIn: Signed in as {{name}} – log out first to use this link.
auth.unreachable.title: Can't reach MealMate
auth.unreachable.text: Check your connection and that Tailscale is on, then try again.
hints.label: Tips
hints.homeScreen.title: Add MealMate to your Home Screen
hints.homeScreen.text: Tap the Share button in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen". MealMate then opens like an app. You may have to log in there once.
hints.tailscale.title: Keep Tailscale on
hints.tailscale.text: MealMate is only reachable through Tailscale. If the app can't connect, check that Tailscale is on.
me.profile.title: Profile
me.privacy.title: Privacy
me.privacy.text: Your partner always sees your meals and lists.
me.privacy.mealsPublicHint: Everyone can see your meals and add them to their lists.
me.privacy.listsPublicHint: Everyone can see your shopping lists (read-only) and copy them.
me.security.title: Security
me.security.resetBy: Your password was reset by {{name}} on {{date}}.
me.security.resetByLink: Your password was reset with a reset link on {{date}}.
me.password.title: Change password
me.password.text: All your other devices will be logged out.
me.password.changed: Password changed. Your other devices have been logged out.
me.sessions.title: Logged-in devices
me.sessions.logoutAllText: Every device, including this one, has to log in again.
me.logoutPending.text: If you log out now, they will be lost.
couple.title: Couple
couple.text: As a couple you see each other's meals and lists and can shop together.
couple.endText: Each list stays with the person who created it, and sharing is switched off on all lists. You can no longer edit each other's lists.
couple.outgoing: Request sent to {{name}}. Waiting for an answer.
couple.incoming: {{name}} would like to be a couple with you.
couple.nobody: There is nobody else here yet.
admin.title: Administration
admin.users.title: Users
admin.users.self: That's you. Another admin can change your account.
admin.users.deactivateText: They are logged out right away and can't log in until you reactivate them. Their meals, lists and couple stay.
admin.users.resetLinkLabel: Create a password reset link for {{name}}
admin.users.resetMessage:
Hi {{name}}, here's your link to set a new MealMate password:

1. Make sure Tailscale is on.
2. Tap this link and choose a new password: {{url}}

The link works once, until {{date}}.
admin.users.deleteText: Lists they share with a partner move to the partner. Everything else of theirs – meals, photos, lists and history – is deleted. This can't be undone.
admin.invites.title: Invites
admin.invites.createText: Create a link, then share it. It works once and always creates a normal user.
admin.invites.tailscaleHint: Create it in the Tailscale admin console. If you fill it in, the message tells the new person to accept it first.
admin.invites.message:
You're invited to MealMate, our meal planner and shopping list app.

1. Install the Tailscale app, sign in and keep Tailscale on.
2. Then tap this link to create your account: {{url}}

The link works once, until {{date}}.
admin.categories.title: Categories
admin.categories.text: Put the categories in the order you walk through your supermarket. Shopping lists follow this order. Each move is saved at once. Tap a name to change it.
admin.categories.deleteItems_one: {{count}} free-text item on drafts moves to “{{other}}”.
admin.categories.deleteItems_other: {{count}} free-text items on drafts move to “{{other}}”.
admin.categories.deleteKeeps: Lists being shopped and done lists stay as they are. This can't be undone.
admin.events.title: Activity log
admin.events.action.userResetLink: {{actor}} created a password reset link for {{target}}
admin.events.action.categoryReorder: {{actor}} changed the order of the categories
admin.events.action.categoryRenameOther: {{actor}} changed the name of the category {{name}} in another language
admin.system.title: System
admin.system.backupText: The server backs up every six hours, and the Mac fetches the backups. Before planned maintenance, such as swapping the SD card, start one more.
admin.system.backupNone: No backup yet. The last backup shows here once the server has made one.
admin.system.backupRequested: Backup requested. The server starts it within a minute; check back here in a few minutes.
admin.system.diskNone: No disk check yet. The free space shows here once the server has checked it.
admin.system.diskLow: Space is running low: less than 20% is free.
share.copied: Copied – paste it into a message.
share.failed: Couldn't copy. Tap the link field and copy it yourself.
lists.detail.readOnly: This is {{name}}'s list. You can look at it and copy it, but not change it.
lists.detail.leftOut_one: {{count}} meal was left out: you can't see it, or it no longer exists.
lists.detail.leftOut_other: {{count}} meals were left out: you can't see them, or they no longer exist.
lists.detail.name: Name
lists.detail.nameHint: Leave it empty to use “{{name}}”. The date is always added.
lists.detail.shareHint: {{name}} sees this list and can change it.
lists.detail.exportCopied: Copied – paste the list into a note or message.
lists.detail.deleteText: The list is deleted for everyone who can see it. This can't be undone.
lists.detail.addMealFailed: The meal is saved, but it couldn't be added to the list: {{error}}
lists.meals.title: Meals
lists.meals.empty: No meals yet. Add some and the shopping list below fills itself.
lists.picker.title: Add meals
lists.picker.text: Choose the servings, then add. Adding a meal again raises its servings.
lists.extra.label: Add an item
lists.extra.hint: Pick a matching ingredient, or add what you typed as free text.
lists.lines.title: Shopping list
lists.lines.hiddenText: Only for this list, e.g. because you still have it at home.
lists.shop.readOnly: Only people who may change this list can check things off.
lists.shop.finishText: The list stays under Lists, marked as done. You can reopen it.
lists.sync.unreachable: Can't reach MealMate – no signal or Tailscale off?
sync.waitingTooLong: Some changes have been waiting for more than an hour. Open MealMate with a connection to send them.
sync.offline.shopping: You're offline. Checking off, extra items and finishing still work; everything else needs a connection.
sync.offline.list: You're offline. Changes to this list need a connection.
sync.offline.page: You're offline. This page needs a connection.
sync.noStorage: MealMate can't store anything on this device right now: changes made without a connection are lost when the app is closed.
sync.rejected_one: A change to “{{name}}” could not be saved: {{reason}}
sync.rejected_other: {{count}} changes to “{{name}}” could not be saved: {{reason}}
sync.discarded_one: {{count}} change to a list you no longer have access to was discarded.
sync.discarded_other: {{count}} changes to a list you no longer have access to were discarded.
sync.invalid_one: {{count}} change could not be saved and was discarded.
sync.invalid_other: {{count}} changes could not be saved and were discarded.
sync.notQueued: Your change could not be saved because you're not signed in any more.
lists.done.note: Bought on {{date}}. Lines that weren't checked off are greyed out.
meals.search.label: Search meals
meals.field.name: Name
meals.field.servingsHint: The amounts below are for this many servings (1–99).
meals.field.tagsHint: Up to 10 tags, e.g. “quick” or “vegetarian”. Press Enter to add one.
meals.field.tagsFull: That's 10 tags. Remove one to add another.
meals.field.ingredientsEmpty: No ingredients yet. Search for one below, or create it there.
meals.field.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. It is made smaller before uploading.
meals.field.photoChosen: Photo chosen. The preview isn't available in this browser.
meals.row.label: Ingredient {{name}}
meals.detail.deleteText: The meal and its photo are deleted. Copies other people made of it stay. This can't be undone.
meals.detail.photoFailed: The meal is saved, but the photo wasn't: {{error}}
meals.ingredients.title: Ingredients
meals.instructions.title: Instructions
meals.nutrition.title: Nutrition
meals.nutrition.empty: Add ingredients with amounts to see the nutrition.
meals.nutrition.incomplete: Incomplete: only what can be calculated is counted. Missing:

meals.nutrition.reason.not_convertible: {{name}}: the amount can't be converted (weight of one piece or density missing)
ingredients.search.label: Search ingredients
ingredients.form.text: Ingredients are shared: everyone sees your changes.
ingredients.form.nutritionHint: Leave a value empty if it is unknown.
ingredients.form.userEdited: Changed in MealMate: updates from Open Food Facts keep it.
ingredients.field.name: Name
ingredients.field.categoryGone: This category no longer exists. Pick another one.
ingredients.field.baseUnitHint: The nutrition values are per 100 g or 100 ml of it.
ingredients.field.densityHint: Optional, converts between g and ml, e.g. 0.92 for olive oil.
ingredients.field.brandHint: Optional, e.g. “REWE”. Another brand of the same thing is another ingredient.
ingredients.field.baseUnitEditHint: The nutrition values are per 100 g or 100 ml of it. Changing it converts nothing: check the values.
ingredients.field.barcodeHint: Optional: the 8, 12 or 13 digits under the bars.
ingredients.field.barcodeFixed: The barcode of the product from Open Food Facts.
ingredients.field.barcodeOffHint: Changing it turns off the updates from Open Food Facts for this ingredient: they would bring another product's values.
ingredients.similar.title: Similar ingredients already exist:
ingredients.nutrition.title: Nutrition per 100 {{unit}}
ingredients.pending.title: Open Food Facts has newer values:
ingredients.admin.title: Administration
ingredients.admin.text: Merge duplicates into one ingredient, or delete an ingredient nothing uses.
ingredients.admin.mergeText: Choose the ingredient that stays. Everything that uses {{name}} moves there, then {{name}} is deleted.
ingredients.admin.mergeConfirmText: All uses of {{from}} in meals and lists move to {{into}}, and {{from}} is deleted. Its barcode moves too if {{into}} has none. This can't be undone.
ingredients.admin.deleteText: That only works while nothing uses the ingredient. This can't be undone.
ingredients.picker.label: Search ingredient
ingredients.offSearch.title: Search Open Food Facts
ingredients.offSearch.text: Search by product name and brand, e.g. “Vollmilch Weidehof”. Choosing a product fills in the form.
ingredients.offSearch.label: Product name or brand
ingredients.offSearch.empty: Nothing found – try brand and product name, or enter the values yourself.
ingredients.offSearch.slow: Open Food Facts is slow – try again.
scanner.title: Scan barcode
scanner.dialogText: Scan or type the barcode of a package. The ingredient it belongs to is added to the meal.
scanner.camera.label: Camera image
scanner.camera.hint: Hold the barcode inside the frame.
scanner.camera.tip: Tip: keep about 20 cm away; on round packages, hold the bars upright.
scanner.camera.denied: MealMate may not use the camera. Allow it in the settings, or type the barcode below.
scanner.camera.unavailable: No camera available. Type the barcode below.
scanner.camera.failed: The camera scanner couldn't start. Type the barcode below.
scanner.manual.label: Barcode
scanner.manual.hint: Or type the 8, 12 or 13 digits under the bars.
scanner.invalidBarcode: {{barcode}} isn't a valid barcode. Please check the digits.
scanner.notFound: Not found ({{barcode}}) – enter the values yourself.
scanner.offUnavailable: Open Food Facts is slow ({{barcode}}) – try again or enter the values yourself.
scanner.fieldText: Scan or type the barcode of the package. It is only filled into the field.
scanner.form.textFound: Check the values, correct them if needed, and save.
scanner.form.textNew: Enter the values from the package and save.
scanner.link.title: Add the barcode to an ingredient

scanner.link.hasBarcode: {{name}} already has a barcode. Another package or brand is another ingredient: save it as a new one instead.

reminder.1: Didn't forget anything? Toilet paper? Salt?
reminder.2: Running low on milk? Worth a second look in the fridge.
reminder.3: Toothpaste, washing-up liquid, bin bags – still got enough?
reminder.4: Taking the empty bottles back? They won't return themselves.
reminder.5: Got your shopping bags? Or is it bag number ten again?
reminder.6: Coffee! Nobody is nice tomorrow morning without coffee.
reminder.8: Batteries, light bulbs, tape – the things you only miss when they're gone.
reminder.9: Shopping hungry? All the more reason to stick to the list.
reminder.10: Birthday coming up? Candles? Something bubbly?
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.intro: Temporary test screen for the platform spike. Every test writes a result; the report at the end collects them.
diag.endpointsOff: The diagnostics endpoints are off: set MEALMATE_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED=true in /srv/mealmate/.env and restart.
diag.env.title: Environment
diag.share.title: Share
diag.share.note: Tests whether the share sheet still opens after a request and a wait.
diag.camera.title: Camera and barcode
diag.camera.note: Scan a real EAN. In iOS 26 Home Screen apps the camera image may be rotated: note the size, facing mode and the barcode's orientation.
diag.cookie.title: Cookie carry-over
diag.cookie.steps: Set in Safari, then check in the Home Screen app. Set in the Home Screen app, then check after force-quitting it and after restarting the phone.
diag.server.title: Request as the server sees it
diag.server.note: Behind tailscale serve, client_host should be the phone's tailnet IP and scheme https.
diag.storage.title: Storage
diag.storage.note: Write the markers, restart the phone, open this page again: are they still there?
diag.offline.title: Offline and lie-fi
diag.offline.steps: Turn on airplane mode, close the app completely, open it again: MealMate must appear immediately. Then open Me → Diagnostics: “App start” shows whether the service worker served it.
diag.offline.lieFi: Lie-fi: with airplane mode off and Tailscale on, unplug the Pi's network cable (or switch the Pi off), close and reopen the app: it must appear immediately and show your lists; after a few seconds it says it can't reach MealMate.
diag.report.title: Report
diag.report.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text below instead.
diag.report.masked: Addresses are masked for the public repository.
